gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.title: MTR performance
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.activ: Fixes for MTR 4.0.5's renderer. Off = MTR's own code.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.unche: This MTR version was not checked: the fixes stay off.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.merge: Draws each MTR model (trains, 3D rails, objects) with one call per material instead of one per model part per material: about half the draw calls for trains. Applies to models loaded after the change; use Reload below for the rest.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.shade: With a shader pack (Iris), MTR re-binds the whole shader for every part of every train and rail piece, every frame. This sets only the part's position instead. No effect without a shader pack.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.shado: With a shader pack, MTR draws every train a second time for shadows. This draws only the outside of each car for shadows, and windows and other see-through parts cast none. No effect without a shader pack.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.loadi: Reads train OBJ files about 4x faster and builds their GPU data about 2x faster, with the same result as MTR. Also stops MTR recompiling its shaders every time a train model loads (Joban Client Mod does that part too; with JCM installed this switch leaves it to JCM).
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.backg: Reads a train's OBJ files on a worker thread instead of freezing a frame, and all files of a train at once. The train appears a moment later instead of the game stuttering. Needs faster model loading.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.doors: Every frame MTR looks at every block around each doorway of each stopped train to see whether there is a platform. This remembers what it found until a block changes. Same result, much less work per frame.
MTR drops a train model a minute after it was last drawn, but keeps its memory and GPU buffers for the rest of the session. This gives them back. Applies to models loaded after the change.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.overl: Shows MTR's draw calls and render time per frame on the F3 screen, to compare with the fixes on and off.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.reloa: Same as F3+T: reloads resource packs so every train is rebuilt with the current settings. Takes a while with large packs.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.inter: Train cars farther away than this are drawn without seats, poles and other interior parts (MTR's interior render stages). Lights stay on.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.rail_: 3D rail pieces farther away than this are drawn as MTR's flat rail texture, which costs almost nothing, instead of one model per half block. Tall rail models (catenary, walls) keep their model.
Beyond this, rails are drawn as one long flat strip per few blocks, and tall rail models as one stretched model per two blocks. With cheaper shadows on, shadows always use this.
gui.aurelia_transit_utilities.perf.box.t: Train cars farther away than this are drawn as a plain box in the train's colour, and their model is not loaded until they come closer. The train you ride is always drawn in full.
